game.title: Starlight Drummer

plan.title: Starlight Drummer
plan.concept: A cosmic music-performance game where you play as a drummer on a starlit concert stage, tapping in time with escalating beat patterns across multiple songs. Each stage introduces faster BPM and trickier rhythms, helping players learn beat matching, tempo, and steady timing while the crowd reacts to their accuracy.
features: Multiple original tracks with rising BPM
Tap patterns that grow in complexity
Starry concert visuals with performance effects
mechanics: accuracy scoring based on timing window
plan.gameplay_summary: Players tap along to incoming beat cues, aiming to hit each note on time as the song speeds up and patterns become more complex. Strong timing builds combos and boosts the crowd’s energy, while missed beats reduce performance momentum.
plan.visual_style_summary: Warm stage-light purple and gold palette with a cosmic concert atmosphere. Bright starbursts, glowing drum effects, and an energized audience create a celebratory performance feel.
plan.player_appearance: cosmic drummer with glowing drum kit
plan.subject: music and rhythm
plan.learning_objective: Players will improve beat matching, tempo awareness, and rhythmic timing through progressively challenging music patterns.
plan.controls: tap/click on beat cues or use assigned keys
plan.replayability: Players can replay songs to improve accuracy, raise combo scores, and master harder rhythmic patterns.

game.request: Starlight Drummer — a rhythm and music performance game. Play as a cosmic drummer on a starlit concert stage, tapping in time with escalating beat patterns across multiple songs. Each stage is a new track with faster BPM and trickier tap patterns, teaching beat matching, tempo and rhythm keeping. Warm stage-light purple and gold palette, crowd energy grows with your accuracy.

spec.title: Starlight Drummer
spec.description: Step onto the cosmic concert stage and tap along to escalating beat patterns across 7 stellar tracks. Build combos, ignite the crowd, and master rhythm from warm grooves to blazing tempo.
spec.subject: Music & Rhythm
spec.learning_objective: Students will develop beat-matching accuracy, tempo awareness, and rhythmic pattern recognition through progressively complex drum performances, learning foundational concepts including quarter notes, eighth notes, backbeat, syncopation, shuffle feel, and polyrhythm.
spec.controls: Tap or click anywhere on the stage (or press Spacebar / Enter) in time with the glowing beat markers. On mobile, tap anywhere on the screen. Consecutive accurate hits build your combo multiplier and energise the crowd.

visual_theme.player_name: Cosmic Drummer — a neon-lit drummer silhouette on a starlit concert stage

achievements.label: Perfect Round — Zero misses in a single stage
Crowd Roar — Pass Stage 5 with 90%+ accuracy
Flawless Tour — Complete 3 consecutive stages without a single miss
Speed Demon — Pass Stage 7 with 80%+ accuracy

stages.title: Stage 1 — Warm-Up Groove
stages.lesson_tip: Feel the steady pulse! Taps land exactly on beats 1, 2, 3 and 4 — these are quarter notes in 4/4 time. One tap per beat, evenly spaced. Stay relaxed and let the glow guide you.

stages.title: Stage 2 — Stardust March
stages.lesson_tip: Every other step now gets a tap — these are eighth notes, twice as frequent as quarter notes. Count '1-and-2-and-3-and-4-and' aloud to feel eight evenly spaced taps filling each bar.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Cosmic Backbeat
stages.lesson_tip: The backbeat places strong accents on beats 2 and 4 — the snare hits you hear in rock and pop. Notice how beats 1 and 3 anchor the bar while 2 and 4 give it that satisfying forward snap.

stages.title: Stage 4 — Nebula Syncopation
stages.lesson_tip: Syncopation shifts accents off the main beats onto the 'ands' between them, creating rhythmic surprise and tension. Keep the steady 4/4 pulse in your head and let the off-beat hits fall naturally around it.

stages.title: Stage 5 — Solar Flare Shuffle
stages.lesson_tip: A shuffle groups sixteenth-note pairs so the first is held longer and the second is short — giving music a swinging, bouncing feel. Count '1-e-and-a' for each beat and feel the uneven lilt under the pattern.

stages.title: Stage 6 — Pulsar Polyrhythm
stages.lesson_tip: Polyrhythm layers two independent rhythmic cycles simultaneously. This pattern weaves groups of 3 hits against a steady background of 4 beats, a technique common in West African drumming, jazz and Afro-Cuban music. Focus on the accented peaks to stay anchored.

stages.title: Stage 7 — Starlight Grand Finale
stages.lesson_tip: The finale fuses every concept — quarter-note anchors, eighth-note runs, backbeat snaps, syncopated off-beats and polyrhythmic clusters — into one blazing performance at peak tempo. Trust your muscle memory, breathe steadily, and let the groove carry you to the finish!
